name: daedalus
description: Shared engineering rules and workflow plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: daedalus-core
plugins.description: Shared engineering rules loaded at session start, plus the code-review and security-review skills, with Matt Pocock's skills as the engineering workflow.

plugins.name: daedalus-writing
plugins.description: On-demand writing and editorial review in Vietnamese, English, and Japanese.

plugins.name: daedalus-springboot
plugins.description: Spring Boot conventions, patterns, security, verification, hexagonal architecture and JPA skills, plus a Java build-error agent.

plugins.name: daedalus-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure: Docker patterns, plus the official AWS (aws-core) and Terraform plugins.

plugins.name: daedalus-postgres
plugins.description: PostgreSQL query, schema, indexing, and security patterns.

plugins.name: daedalus-python
plugins.description: Python patterns and pytest testing skills.

plugins.name: daedalus-fastapi
plugins.description: FastAPI patterns: Pydantic v2 schemas, dependency injection, async handlers, auth, and testing.

plugins.name: daedalus-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript patterns for strict, type-safe code.

plugins.name: daedalus-frontend
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic frontend skills: accessibility, interface polish, Vite, and Playwright E2E testing.

plugins.name: daedalus-react
plugins.description: React patterns, performance, testing, frontend patterns and accessibility skills, plus a React build-error agent.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Third-party (JuliusBrussee/caveman 4.1.0), pinned to a reviewed commit: terse replies.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Third-party (DietrichGebert/ponytail 5.3.3), pinned to a reviewed commit: simplest working solution.
